conclusion: Reject replacing calibrated vector fusion with the existing heading-only update as a general improvement: every GPS and denied velocity pair is worse, and almost all attitude/yaw pairs are worse. Some position components improve; all are retained.
limitations: Development ablation on now-inspected captures, not untouched validation.
Native magnetic/height policies remain different; this does not identify an intrinsic algorithm ranking.
No new ESKF algorithm, gain tuning or default change.
NEES remains descriptive; per-sensor ESKF NIS and broader faults/outages are open.
